limitations: Desktop Chromium, real Open Project file chooser, visible AUDIO controls and visible Build & Run. Browser state reads verify actions; project state is not injected.

This verifies usability and byte-identical rebuilding of the supplied recovered lead projects. It does not establish native decoder generality, whole-song recovery, audible listening, physical-device behavior, independent emulator compatibility, or NES hardware timing.
The empty generated scene is an intentional carrier for recovered music. No gameplay or artwork recovery is claimed.
